texts.preamble: Khushilal Maina vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr. on 26 October, 2018 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Cr.R No. 5168/2018 (Khushilal Meina Vs State of M.P.) Gwalior Dated 26/10/2018 Shri Rajmani Bansal, learned counsel for the applicant.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was on bail during trial as well as at the appellate stage and they did not misuse the liberty of bail granted to them. On the other hand, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State opposes the bail application.
